title: Biology of Viruses and Viral Diseases

questions.question: AM 16. List of viruses - name whether it is DNA/RNA, Enveloped/not, and name an antiviral used for treatment (not immunotherapy) (whole chart - 3): Measles, Mumps, EBV, Zika, Ebola, Influenza, Hepatitis B (and Coronavirus)

cohort_answer.text: Measles - Paramyxoviridae, ssRNA(-), enveloped: nothing (ribavirin trialed in severe cases, vitamin A). Mumps - Paramyxoviridae, ssRNA(-), enveloped: nothing. EBV - Herpesviridae, dsDNA, enveloped: nothing (GCV, cidofovir tried). Zika - Flaviviridae, ssRNA(+), enveloped: nothing. Ebola - Filovirus, ssRNA(-), enveloped: remdesivir, or Ervebo vaccine. Influenza - Orthomyxoviridae, ssRNA(-), enveloped: Oseltamivir/zanamivir/baloxavir. Hepatitis B - Hepadnaviridae, partially ds/partly ss circular DNA, enveloped: tenofovir, lamivudine, entecavir. Chikungunya - Togaviridae, ssRNA(+), enveloped: no Rx. Coronavirus - positive sense ssRNA, enveloped with club-shaped spikes.

parts.text: Fill in the table: Nucleic Acid, Envelope, and Antiviral for Mumps, Measles, Hep B, EBV, Ebola, Zika, Rotavirus, Bocavirus, Parvovirus.

cohort_answer.text:
Mumps | Single-stranded, negative sense RNA | Enveloped | None - supportive care
Measles | Single-stranded, negative sense RNA | Enveloped | Vitamin A 200 000 IU PO daily x 2 days in children with suspected Vit A deficiency; Supportive care
Hep B | Double-stranded DNA virus | Enveloped | Tenofovir, Lamivudine, Entecavir
EBV | Double stranded DNA virus | Enveloped | Ganciclovir (Ian - meh)
Ebola | Single-stranded, negative sense RNA | Enveloped | Supportive care
Zika | Single-stranded, positive sense RNA | Enveloped | Supportive care
Rotavirus | Double-stranded RNA | Nonenveloped | Oral rehydration therapy, zinc supplementation in zinc deficient areas
Bocavirus | Single-stranded DNA | Nonenveloped | Supportive care
Parvovirus | Single-stranded DNA | Nonenveloped | Supportive care

questions.question: Fill the table below regarding 6 viruses with malignant potential: HHV-8, EBV, HPV, HIV, HepB/HepC, HTLV-1 (Virus | Associated Malignancy)

parts.text: Fill in the associated malignancy for each virus listed.

cohort_answer.text: HHV-8 | Kaposi's sarcoma. EBV | Burkitt's Lymphoma, gastric cancer. HPV | Cervical cancer. HIV | CNS lymphoma. HepB/HepC | HCC. HTLV-1 | Leukemia/Lymphoma.
